scroll_title: The Staff of the Red Sea
clue: I grew up in the royal palace of Pharaoh, yet I parted the Red Sea to lead God's people out of Egypt. Who am I?
fact: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the Lord divided the waters.

clue: I prayed three times a day toward Jerusalem despite the king's decree. God shut the lions' mouths and saved me. Who am I?
fact: Daniel trusted in God, and God sent an angel to shut the lions' mouths.

scroll_title: Victory by a Sling and Stone
clue: With no armor or sword, I defeated the Philistine giant Goliath with just a sling and a smooth stone. Who am I?
fact: David came in the name of the Lord of Hosts and defeated Goliath.

clue: When God warned of a global flood, I built a massive ark of gopher wood to save my family and the animals. Who am I?
fact: Noah walked with God and built the ark according to all that God commanded.

clue: I challenged the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel. When I prayed, fire fell from heaven and consumed the altar. Who am I?
fact: The fire of the Lord fell and proved that the Lord alone is God.

clue: I ran away from God's call to preach to Nineveh. After spending three days inside a great fish, I repented and obeyed. Who am I?
fact: Jonah prayed to the Lord from the belly of the fish, and God delivered him.

clue: I once persecuted Christians, but a blinding light from heaven on the road to Damascus transformed me into an apostle. Who am I?
fact: Saul encountered the risen Christ and became Paul, the great apostle to the Gentiles.

clue: I had been dead and buried in a tomb for four days until Jesus wept and called out my name to come forth. Who am I?
fact: Jesus cried out, 'Lazarus, come forth!' and the man who had died came out alive.

scroll_title: The King Who Asked for Wisdom
clue: When God offered me any gift, I did not ask for riches or long life, but for wisdom to lead God's people. Who am I?
fact: God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure.

clue: When I saw Jesus walking on the Sea of Galilee, I stepped out of the boat and walked on the water toward Him. Who am I?
fact: Peter walked on the water toward Jesus by faith.

clue: In this humble city of Judea, the Savior of the world, Jesus Christ, was born in a manger as foretold by prophets. Which city is it?
fact: Bethlehem of Judea was prophesied by Micah as the birthplace of the Messiah.

clue: The walls of this great city collapsed after the Israelites marched around it for seven days and blew trumpets. Which city is it?
fact: When the people shouted with a great shout, the wall of Jericho fell flat.

clue: As long as I remained a Nazirite with uncut hair, I possessed supernatural strength to defeat lions and armies. Who am I?
fact: Samson was chosen from birth to deliver Israel from the Philistines.

clue: My father gave me a coat of many colors. After being sold into Egypt, God raised me to rule and save my family from famine. Who am I?
fact: Joseph forgave his brothers, saying God meant it for good to save lives.

scroll_title: The First Miracle at a Wedding
clue: In which city of Galilee did Jesus perform His first recorded miracle by turning water into finest wine at a wedding?
fact: Jesus manifested His glory at Cana of Galilee, and His disciples believed in Him.

clue: In which famous river was Jesus baptized by John the Baptist as the Holy Spirit descended like a dove from heaven?
fact: The voice of the Father spoke from heaven at Jesus' baptism in the Jordan River.

clue: On which holy mountain did God descend in fire and thunder to give Moses the Two Tablets of the Ten Commandments?
fact: Mount Sinai was where God established His covenant with the children of Israel.

clue: I believed God's promise that I would have a son at 100 years old. God accounted my faith for righteousness. Who am I?
fact: Abraham is known as the father of all who believe in God's promises.

clue: I refused to bow to a golden idol and was thrown into a fiery furnace heated seven times hotter, yet God saved me. Who am I?
fact: The Son of God walked with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the fire.

clue: I was a ruler of the Jews who came to Jesus by night to learn what it means to be born again of the Spirit. Who am I?
fact: Jesus told Nicodemus that God so loved the world that He gave His only Son.

clue: When I prayed during battle, the sun stood still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon for a whole day. Who am I?
fact: There has been no day like that before or since, when the Lord heeded the voice of a man.

clue: I risked my royal crown and my life to approach the king uninvited in order to save my Jewish people from Haman's plot. Who am I?
fact: Esther declared, 'If I perish, I perish,' and saved her people from destruction.

clue: I was a short tax collector in Jericho who climbed a sycamore tree just to see Jesus pass by. Who am I?
fact: Jesus stayed at Zacchaeus's house and proclaimed salvation had come to his home.

scroll_title: The Day of Tongues of Fire
clue: On which feast day did the Holy Spirit descend with the sound of a rushing wind and tongues of fire upon 120 disciples?
fact: Three thousand souls were saved on the Day of Pentecost when Peter preached.

clue: Which New Testament book was written by the apostle John on the Island of Patmos, revealing the glory of Christ and the end times?
fact: Revelation promises a special blessing to everyone who reads and hears its prophetic words.
